## Walkthrough The pull request updates the `workerWaitFor2ReadyMasters` function to include arbiter hosts in readiness verification alongside master hosts with completed installation status. Corresponding test cases are added to verify this behavior in both worker role scenarios. ## Changes |Cohort / File(s)|Summary| |---|---| |**Implementation**
`src/installer/installer.go`|Modified `workerWaitFor2ReadyMasters` to sum "done" counts from both master and arbiter hosts when determining installation readiness; arbiter count is included if lookup succeeds and returns at least one arbiter.| |**Test Coverage**
`src/installer/installer_test.go`|Added "TNA with arbiter" test case and updated "worker role happy flow" test to include expectations for arbiter role readiness checks with appropriate host lists; both now verify the updated readiness logic.| ## Estimated code review effort 🎯 2 (Simple) | ⏱️ ~10 minutes
✨ Finishing Touches
🧪 Generate unit tests (beta) - [ ] Create PR with unit tests

🧹 Nitpick comments (1)
src/installer/installer.go (1)
`680-688`: **LGTM - The arbiter counting logic correctly addresses the TNA deadlock.** The implementation correctly counts done arbiters toward the `minMasterNodes` threshold when available, allowing workers to proceed when 1 master + 1 arbiter are done. The conditional `arbErr == nil && len(arbiters) > 0` ensures backward compatibility with non-TNA clusters. **Consider logging arbiter fetch errors for debuggability.** When `arbErr != nil`, the error is silently ignored. While this is safe (falls back to original behavior), logging the error at debug/warn level could help troubleshoot TNA-related issues.
Optional: Add logging for arbiter fetch errors ```diff // checking whether there are arbiter nodes in the cluster arbiters, arbErr := i.inventoryClient.ListsHostsForRole(ctx, string(models.HostRoleArbiter)) + if arbErr != nil { + i.log.WithError(arbErr).Debug("Failed to get arbiter hosts, skipping arbiter count") + } if arbErr == nil && len(arbiters) > 0 { numberOfNodes += numDone(arbiters) } ```
🤖 Prompt for AI Agents ``` Verify each finding against the current code and only fix it if needed. In `@src/installer/installer.go` around lines 680 - 688, The arbiter fetch error (arbErr) is currently ignored; update the block around i.inventoryClient.ListsHostsForRole(ctx, string(models.HostRoleArbiter)) to log arbErr when it is non-nil (use process logger or the package's logger at debug/warn level) before falling back to the original behavior; keep the existing conditional that only counts arbiters when arbErr == nil && len(arbiters) > 0 and do not change numDone or the final return logic. ```
